# Makefile for a LaTeX project using XeLaTeX + biber
# Usage:
#   make          - compile the document
#   make clean    - remove auxiliary files
#   make distclean - remove all generated files including PDF

TEX = xelatex
BIB = biber
MAIN = main

.PHONY: all clean distclean

all: $(MAIN).pdf

$(MAIN).pdf: $(MAIN).tex
	$(TEX) -interaction=nonstopmode $(MAIN).tex
	$(BIB) $(MAIN)
	$(TEX) -interaction=nonstopmode $(MAIN).tex
	$(TEX) -interaction=nonstopmode $(MAIN).tex

clean:
	rm -f *.aux *.log *.out *.toc *.lof *.lot
	rm -f *.bbl *.blg *.bcf *.run.xml
	rm -f *.idx *.ilg *.ind *.thm *.glo *.ist
	rm -f *.synctex.gz *.fdb_latexmk *.fls

distclean: clean
	rm -f $(MAIN).pdf
